entries.2fcc0886480d83ea: Under the corporate philosophy 'Let us aim to be a company that creates education and culture and contributes to society through developing people for the 21st century', the company states that it maintains a frontline-first stance. Its management strategy states that it focuses on 6 priorities: developing new types of teaching materials; enhancing product planning for teaching aids and expanding sales channels; developing and selling hybrid teaching materials that combine paper and digital, and software that reduces teachers' workload; securing rights to highly original teaching materials and teaching aids; streamlining consolidated management; and creating teaching materials that are easy for everyone to use. It also aims to transform from a teaching materials company into a comprehensive educational services company.
